scope: Visible cattle per still image; no whole-property inventory or animal identity claim
image_selection: Deterministic sample of up to three nonempty-label and three empty-label images per flight, before inference; no selection by model results. This balanced sample is not population prevalence.
model: Official Ultralytics YOLOv8n COCO pretrained baseline
selection_objective: Minimum calibration false positives plus false negatives; ties use lower count MAE, then higher confidence
correction_operations: FP removals plus FN additions under label matching; excludes inspection, localization edits, and verification time
human_timing: Actual participant review only. Never convert correction operations or agent time into human time saved.
decision_rule: No efficiency claim until a timed human comparison shows lower review time at comparable final accuracy. An assisted prototype can proceed for testing when correction operations are lower than marking every annotated animal, but that is only a proxy.
limitations: Small repeated-view sample; report flights as clusters
Held-out flights are not necessarily unseen farms
Public image provenance does not validate borrower collateral
COCO baseline failure does not rule out cattle-specific training
